hero.title:
The Dance of Elements.
The Peak of Strategy.
hero.text: Kombo Kart is a strategic card game of automatic battles shaped by drafting, evolution, positioning, and elemental synergies.

origin.label: 02 — Origin
origin.title: From nickname to studio.
origin.p1: Rynia was never meant to be a studio name. Years ago, it was simply a personal nickname—a digital identity I carried through various projects and communities. Over time, it became more than that: a symbol of consistency, discipline, and creative persistence.
origin.p2: When I committed to game development as a serious, long-term practice, the choice was natural. Rynia Studios isn't a company building games. It's a person with a vision, building games with intention, learning in public, and evolving through every iteration.

vision.label: 03 — Vision & Mission
vision.title: Discipline, Iteration, Evolution.
vision.visionText: To build a recognizable indie game studio by creating simple, focused, and iterative games that evolve over time.
vision.missionText: To design and develop small-scale, manageable games while continuously improving skills, systems, and production efficiency.

press.label: 05 — Press Kit
press.title: For press & content creators.
press.p1: Everything you need to cover Kombo Kart—factsheet, descriptions, and contact details. Screenshots and trailer will be added as development progresses.
press.factsheetText:
Developer: Rynia Studios (solo)
Engine: Unity
Platform: iOS / Mobile
Genre: Mobile auto-battler card game
Status: In development
Discord: discord.gg/AmHTh8eyA
press.shortText: Kombo Kart is a mobile auto-battler card game where drafting, card evolution, and positioning decide every battle.
press.p2: Kombo Kart follows a simple loop: draft your cards, evolve them, choose their position, then watch the battle play out automatically. The philosophy behind the game is simple—few cards, many decisions. As development continues, the drafting pool and elemental synergies will expand to give every run its own shape.

development.label: 06 — Development
development.title: Active Systems & Focus Areas.
development.subtitle: What's actually being built right now.
development.p1: This section tracks the core systems currently in development for Kombo Kart. It represents the heart of the production pipeline and the technical foundation being built.
development.combatText: Core combat systems are being built in Unity, including ticks, card states, targeting, attacks, damage calculation, and elemental damage.
development.cardText: Cards are being structured around elements, roles, positioning, abilities, and evolution to create meaningful decisions with a limited card pool.
development.battleText: Target switching, death states, healing, buffs, debuffs, and elemental synergies are planned as the combat foundation expands.
